title: Podcast app feeds
intro: Use your normal podcast app instead of this page. Each show's feed adds chapters (including sponsor reads, so apps that can skip chapters can skip them). A second feed lists every cut you've exported.
already-made: You already made a feed link. If you saved it, use that one — we can't show it again. Making a new one stops the old link working.
made: Feed link made. Save these links now — they won't be shown again.
new-link-hint: This replaces any link you made before, in every podcast app that used it.
shows-hint: PodFetch's feed lists downloaded episodes only. Turn on auto-download for shows you want in your app.
reach-hint: Your phone needs to reach this server to use these feeds — for example over Tailscale, not just your home Wi-Fi.
chapters-hint: Chapter skipping depends on your podcast app; not every app supports it yet.
